chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Aban ibn Uthman from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
When you desire a child, say during copulation: 'O Allah, grant me a child and make him pious, with no excess or deficiency in his creation, and make his end result good.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication to say during intercourse when wanting a child?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) outlines a specific supplication for conception, emphasizing the dual aspiration for physical perfection and spiritual piety (Taqwa). It reflects the Shia emphasis on integrating divine decree with practical supplication, where the parent's intention shapes the child's destiny. The request for 'no excess or deficiency' highlights the holistic view of health in Islamic tradition, encompassing both bodily integrity and moral character.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you want the child, so say during copulation, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Grant me a child and Make him to be pious, neither there being in his creation any excess nor a deficiency, and Make his posterity to be good’.
en.sarwar: 12. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you want to have a son then at the time of your going to bed with your wife say, “O Lord, grant me a son, make him pious, without any deficiency or extra in his physical condition and make his consequences in goodness.’”
